notes: Initial Schedule TO-I with Offer to Purchase and Letter of Transmittal (excerpt ends mid Letter of Transmittal). Commencement date taken as the Offer to Purchase date, June 21, 2021; the filing does not use the word commencement. Trigger: a 2020 shareholder proposal asked the board for a self-tender for at least 40%; Saba is adviser and ~25.7 million shares expected to be tendered by Saba clients; classed as other. The 'other' condition is the asset coverage requirement (the filing also lists an orderly loan liquidation condition).
